# zhemm

![zhemm function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/blas/29-zhemm.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

C = alpha*H(A)*B + beta*C (Left) or alpha*B*H(A)+beta*C (Right), using only the chosen triangle of A. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: c=zero_matrix_shape_b, alpha=1, beta=1, side=1, matrix_a_type=3.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**zhemm**

Produit hermitien à gauche ou à droite avec accumulation ; seul le triangle choisi est lu. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : c=zero_matrix_shape_b, alpha=1, beta=1, side=1, matrix_a_type=3.

</details>
